content.description: Car split into normal/pushy; moto split into normal, slow-centre and space-seeking custom1; one box-waiting violator archetype; all six rule types with small, mechanism-driven values.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (headway 0.39 s) and M3/share/car (0.0027): tau 1.0 and sigma 0.4 keep cars compliant with a slightly compact discharge; near-zero red running.
Targets M8/car (wrong-lane share 0.056) and M1/car: a small assertive minority with lower tau and larger lcAssertive accepts tighter gaps, raising lane-change risk and shortening discharge headway.

Targets M4/overshoot_share (0.63), M5/moto_density (0.045), M1/moto (0.30 s) and M3/share/moto (0.092): small tau, minGap and minGapLat plus lcSublane and lcPushy let riders filter forward past the stop line and pack densely; moderate impatience with jmDriveAfterRedTime gives a limited red-running share.
Targets M6/approach/s/moto (27 s) and l/moto (28.6 s): a slow-rider archetype with speedFactor 0.7 stretches range-entry-to-stop-line time towards the observed values.

Targets M8/moto (0.247), M4/overshoot_depth (2.0 m), M3/per_cycle (4.4) and the F2 space-seeking events: aggressive lateral parameters and high impatience let these riders encroach, change lane and run the red; custom1 class makes them eligible for queue_space_seeking.

Targets M7a/n_waiting (5.5), M7b/clear_lag (6.7 s) and M6/junction/illegal_l (49 s): a low jmTimegapMinor and small gaps let illegal-left riders enter the box and exit promptly when the opposing stream ends.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto (0.13) and M2/first_delay (2.1 s): p 0.15 for front-row motorcycles in the last 8 s of red reproduces the early-start share; cars excluded because the car share is about 0.001.

Targets M3/share/moto (0.092), M3/per_cycle (4.4) and M3/var_to_mean (1.3): a low base p0 with a mild follower effect k gives roughly the observed share and slight over-dispersion; cars excluded (share 0.003).

Targets F2/p/wrong_lane (0.16-0.23 at short queues), M9a (0.33 veh/cycle), M10a (0.27 veh/cycle) and M5/length (13 m): a 10 m trigger with a 7 s green check fits the short observed queues; wrong_lane dominates, right_lane and sidewalk stay rare.
Targets M7a/release_time (2.6 s) and M7b/clear_lag (6.7 s): a 1 s extra hold on top of SUMO's native release moves box exit time towards the observed delay without changing safety parameters.
Targets M4/lat_moto and M6/approach moto times: slow riders stay on the lane centre (offset 0), which keeps them as a rolling obstacle and lengthens approach times of followers.

reasoning: Split each distribution into archetypes with a clear mechanism: compliant cars, filtering motorcycles, slow centre riders, space-seeking custom1 riders, box-waiting violators. Rules were sized to the observed shares (early start 0.13, moto red running 0.09) and short queues (13 m); shares sum to 1 per distribution.
